t1.RELEASE_NO: key: newest edition (tie-break between two editions of one date); the edition shown comes from the releases input
t1.RELEASE_DATE: key: newest edition — selects its rows
t1.SHEET: skip: the sheet's print title (one sheet per table)
t1.ROW: key: row order — labels are found by text, not by row number
t1.C01: skip: English footnotes and the title column
t1.C02: skip: monthly trend % change, Israelis (the page derives the trend run from the trend values)
t1.C04: skip: monthly trend % change, total (yearly block: unaligned header of the % change columns)
t1.C05: skip: monthly trend, Israelis (yearly block: % change vs last year, computed from the values instead)
t1.C06: skip: monthly trend, tourists (yearly block: % change vs last year)
t1.C08: skip: monthly seasonally adjusted, Israelis (yearly block: % change vs last year, total)
t1.C09: chart-years, chart-share, insight:peak — yearly Israelis (monthly block: SA tourists, not shown)
t1.C10: chart-sa, chart-years, chart-share — monthly seasonally adjusted total; yearly tourists
t1.C11: chart-evac, chart-years, insight:evac, insight:peak — monthly evacuees' nights; yearly total
t1.C12: chart-monthly, chart-ytd, chart-heat, kpi:tour_share, insight:share — monthly Israelis, original; yearly period label
t1.C13: chart-monthly, chart-ytd, kpi:tour_base, insight:tourists — monthly tourists, original
t1.C14: chart-monthly, chart-heat, chart-sa, kpi:month, kpi:month_chg, kpi:ytd, kpi:ytd_chg, insight:month, insight:ytd, insight:season — monthly total, original
t1.C16: chart-monthly, chart-heat — year label of the monthly block (Hebrew side)
releases.TITLE: text: the latest-edition card
releases.HEADLINE: text: the latest-edition card (CBS's one-line summary)
releases.PAGE_URL: text: link to the release on cbs.gov.il
releases.REPORT_PDF_URL: text: link to the written report (PDF)
